description: FO model with draw reconcentration energy, ICP correction, temperature correction, and membrane fouling

unit.name: Thin-film composite FO membrane module
unit.source: McGinnis & Elimelech (2008) Environ. Sci. Technol.; Cath et al. (2006) J. Membrane Sci.

k_mass.note: External concentration polarization mass transfer coefficient

D_eff.note: Effective solute diffusivity in support layer

tau_mem.note: Membrane structural parameter tortuosity factor (effective: S=t*tau/eps; using combined t*tau here)

thickness_m.note: Support layer effective thickness (80 micron; structural parameter S=t*tau~160 micron)

E_a_w_kJ_mol.note: Activation energy for water permeation (Zhao 2012: ~20 kJ/mol)

pi_draw_ref.note: Reference draw osmotic pressure at design

SEC_regen.note: Draw reconcentration SEC at design recovery (McGinnis 2008 estimate)
